# Forbrain Blog

> A comprehensive resource for auditory feedback training, speech therapy, and dyslexia treatment through Forbrain and Soundsory products.

The Forbrain blog features scientific research, clinical case studies, practitioner guides, and news about the Forbrain auditory feedback headset system. It serves speech-language pathologists, educators, dyslexia specialists, and English language learners seeking evidence-based training solutions.

## Key Topics

- Forbrain
- Soundsory
- Auditory feedback
- Dyslexia treatment
- Speech therapy
- Special education
- Scientific research
- ASHA Convention
- AOTA Inspire
- Case studies
- Posture tips
- Working memory
- Attentional capabilities
- English language learning
- Professional development

## Research & Evidence

- [Research Study - Effects of audiophonic loop training with Forbrain on reading accuracy and speed as well as on working memory and short-term memory in dyslexic patients](https://blog.forbrain.com/blog/effects-of-audiophonic-loop-training-with-forbrain-on-reading-accuracy-and-speed-as-well-as-on-working-memory-and-short-term-memory-in-dyslexic-patients): Research study on Forbrain's effects on dyslexia and memory
- [Research Study - Phasic boosting of attentional capabilities with a Forbrain session](https://blog.forbrain.com/blog/research-study-phasic-boosting-of-attentional-capabilities-with-a-forbrain-session): Research study on Forbrain's attentional capability improvements

## Clinical Case Studies & Best Practices

- [Case Study: Using Forbrain for Dyslexia by a Certified Dyslexia Tutor](https://blog.forbrain.com/blog/case-study-using-forbrain-for-dyslexia-by-a-certified-dyslexia-tutor): Dyslexia case study by certified tutor Rosemarie Hoffman
- [Maximizing the Benefits of Forbrain and Soundsory in Your Practice](https://blog.forbrain.com/blog/maximizing-the-benefits-of-forbrain-and-soundsory-in-your-practice): Implementation guide for therapists using Forbrain and Soundsory
